ABOUT US 
			 
		 
	 
 

 
	 
		 
			 
			 Faculty of Education in Banaras Hindu University (B.H.U.) is one of the oldest and important faculties established during the initial three years of establ
ishment of the university. This unique seat of life and light imbibes the best Sanatan traditions (Ancient Indian Traditions) with those of the best in the modern scientific world.
 The Faculty's motto, " विद्या धर्मेण शोभते " ( Vidya Dharmen Shobhate ) – Vidya is Graced by Being is the torch bearer for all teacher trainees and alumni together.Th
e great teacher and the founder visionary Mahamana Madan Mohan Malaviya held a particular conviction that, teachers are the chief architects of the nation. No system of education c
ould succeed without knowledgeable, skilled and patriotic teachers to carry forward the nation. Acting on this vision, the Teachers' Training College (TTC) was established on 1
5 th August, 1918. It is located at Kamachha in the mid-city of Varanasi. Pandit Manohar Lal Zutshi joined as its founding Principal after resigning from his post of Registrar in B
.H.U. He was assisted by two teachers in TTC. 

			 The Kamachha Campus also precedes the foundation of university, as a historic educational site led by Mrs. Annie Besant for the three schools known for edu
cation of young Hindu boys and girls at the Central Hindu College.Fortunately, the TTC found its home at the same educational hub of the university at Kamachha . Students travelled
 to TTC from across the country — Punjab, Rajputana, Bengal, Delhi, Gwalior and beyond to train as teachers. This course of study combined scholastic learning with literary, 
dramatic and athletic activities. Distinguished early Principals and teachers of the College included Pandit Manohar Lal Zutshi, Sant Teja Singh, Pandit C.M. Shukla, Sri L.S. Jha, 
Prof. H.B. Malkani, Acharya Sitaram Chaturvedi and Dr. P.N. Rajdan, among many others who shaped its early character. 

			 In the year 1968 , the Teachers' Training College functioning in its present main building evolved as the Faculty of Education. While retaining its fou
nding purpose there has been steady academic widening with introduction of M.Ed. programme and Ph.D. in Education, B.Ed. Special - V.I. (Visual Impairment) programme, B.Ed. Special
-H.I. (Hearing Impairment) and M.Ed. Special-V.I. (Visual Impairment) programme as well as M.A. in Education. These courses as applicable are approved by the regulatory bodies like
 NCTE, RCI and are as per UGC norms. The Faculty completed its Centenary Year in 2017-18, alongside the University's own centenary celebrations in 2015-16. Recently the Faculty
 celebrated its 109 th foundation day in 2026. 

			 
			 Since its inception, the Faculty has produced teachers, teacher educators and College Principals serving across the nation including NCERT, NIEPA, Central 
and State Universities and State level training institutions across the country in good numbers. The School Principals in KVS, NVS, DSSSB and State Schools across the nation have a
lso been our products. The university leaders serving across India and abroad, including in Nepal, Myanmar, Thailand, Kenya, Nigeria and Denmark are also part of our alumni. Among 
the most distinguished alumni have been Dr. K.L.Shrimali who was trained here in the 1930s before going on to serve as India's Union Minister of Education and later as Vice-Cha
ncellor of Banaras Hindu University; and Shri Harivansh Rai Bachchan, who completed his teacher training here in 1937–38 and is remembered today as one of the Hindi literatur
e's most celebrated poets. In more recent decades, the Faculty has produced Vice-Chancellors including Professor Harikesh Singh (former VC, JPN University, Chhapra, Bihar ), Pr
ofessor H.C.S. Rathore (former VC, CUSB, Gaya, Bihar), Professor Seema Singh (former VC, UPRTOU Prayagraj, U.P) and Professor S.K. Swain (VC, Sikkim University, Sikkim). In the rec
ent past distinguished international fellowships like DAAD and Humboldt (Prof. H.C.S. Rathore) & Fulbright fellowship (Prof. Madhu Kushwaha) added feather to the academic excellenc
e of Faculty. These bonds are sustained today through the Alumni Association of Education, BHU (AAE, BHU), which have active life members, AAE publishes the bilingual International
 Journal Shaikshik Parisamvad: An international journal of Education (SPIJE). The National Journal of Education (NJE) is published regularly by the faculty. 

			 The Faculty seeks to develop in its pupil-teachers and future teacher educators the ethical, moral and intellectual qualities needed to serve as vibrant ag
ents of social and national service; to blend conventional pedagogy with modern ICT-enabled techniques; to prepare teachers to work with and rehabilitate differently-abled children
; to nurture researchers capable of generating new knowledge in the field of education; and to skill all stakeholders to work with resilience, innovate , explore indigenous pedagog
ies for all-round development as per the ethos and expectations of NEP 2020 . 

			 Today, the Faculty facilitates research work in diverse areas of teacher education and education with multidisciplinary perspectives. It has major areas of
 focus like Foundations (Philosophy, Sociology, Psychology) of Education, Pedagogy across all school subjects, Teacher Education, Curriculum Studies, Policy Perspectives in Educati
on, Educational Administration and Management, Language Education (Hindi, English, Sanskrit), Sanskrit Game Based Learning, Environmental Education, Gender education, Equity Issues
 in Education, Special and Inclusive Education, Guidance and counselling, ICT & Educational Technology, Curriculum Development & Evaluation, Indian Knowledge System, Value Educatio
n, Computer-Assisted Instruction, Artificial Intelligence in Education, Distance Education, Innovative pedagogy and Contemporary Issues in Education etc.. Faculty provides good sup
port services in form of good library, laboratories, auditorium, hostels (Dr. Rajendra Prasad Hostel and Dr. Annie Besant Hostel) and play facilities to students at all levels. The
 faculty members are persons of repute in the areas of teacher education and are members of NCTE, RCI and several other state level bodies in the field of education.The rich and pr
oficient administrative staff is a special asset to facilitate students. Various student houses, clubs and NSS units are also functional. Nationally funded research projects by UGC
, ICSSR, NCERT, CSU, IoE-BHU (individual & in collaboration) contribute as the special feature. 

			 This premier seat of training and education of teachers in India continues to work with more vigor — to develop teachers who are rooted in India'
s cultural traditions and equally at home in a digital age; to grow into a resource hub for the continuing education of school teachers and teacher educators, carrying forward the 
conviction with which it began that is, the teacher remains the true architect of society. 

			 OUR MOTTO, VISION, MISSION AND OBJECTIVES 

			 MOTTO: “ विद्या धर्मेण शोभते ” ( Vidya Dharmen Shobhate ) 

			 VISION: T eachers are architects of the society. 

			 MISSION: 

			 1. To ornate pupil teachers and future teacher educators with righteous conduct as reflected in our emblem ‘Vidya Dharmen Shobhate’ 

			 2. To produce teachers embodied with cultural traditions of our society and also modern enough to keep pace with changing times. 

			 OBJECTIVES: 

			 1.To develop all-round personality of teachers/teacher educators to serve as propagators of constitutional values and educational innovations. 

			 2. To inculcate in teachers ethical, moral and intellectual qualities, to act as agents of social awakening, to protect society and humanity from the emerg
ing hazards of the modern world. 

			 3. To train teachers/teacher educators to blend conventional methods and techniques of teaching and learning with modern ICT enabled techniques. 

			 4. To prepare teachers and teacher educators to handle and rehabilitate differently able children. 

			 5. To produce competent researchers having ability to innovate and excel in the creation of frontier knowledge in the field of education.

PAGE_TITLE=Banaras Hindu University, [BHU], Varanasi-221005, U.P., India. - Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi, India.

BODY:
 
	 
		 
			 
			 About BHU 
			 
		 
	 
 

 
	 
		 
			 
			 

			 Banaras Hindu University is an internationally reputed temple of learning, situated in the holy city of Varanasi. This Creative and innovative university w
as founded by the great nationalist leader, Pandit Madan Mohan Malviya, in 1916 with cooperation of great personalities like Dr Annie Besant, who viewed it as the University of Ind
ia. Banaras Hindu University was d under the Parliamentary legislation - B.H.U. Act 1915. It played a stellar role in the independence movement and has developed into the greatest 
center of learning in India. It has produced many great freedom fighters and builders of modern India and has immensely contributed to the progress of the nation through a large nu
mber of renowned scholars, artists, scientists and technologists who have graced its portals. The area of the main campus of this premiere Central University is 1300 acres, having 
well maintained roads, extensive greenery, a temple, an air strip and buildings which are an architectural delight. The Air Field of the campus was started for military training fo
r flying during the second world war. Another campus of the university at Barkachha , in Mirzapur district, covering an area of 2700 acres is coming up. The university comprises 6 
Institutes, 14 Faculties 144 Departments, 4 Inter displinary Centers a constituent college for women's and 3 Constituents Schools, spanning a vast range of subjects pertaining to a
ll branches of humanities,social science,technology, medicine ,science, fine arts and performing arts. It has 6 centres of Advanced Studies, 10 Departments under Special Assistance
 Programme and a large number of specialized Research Centers. Four Degree Colleges of the city are affiliated to the University. Bharat Kala Bhavan, the reputed museum of the univ
ersity, is a treasure trove of rare collections. The 927 bed hospital of the University is equipped with all the modern a menities. The university provides a wide range of faciliti
es for sport and hobbies, has large playgrounds, a big auditorium, a flying club and many auxiliary services and units like Printing Press, Publication Cell,Fruit Preservation Cent
er, Subsidized Canteens, Employment and Information Bureau, Security etc. The University family consists of about 15000 students belonging to all streams of life, castes and religi
ons and races, about 1700 teachers, and nearly 8000 non-teaching staff A large number of students from foreign countries like the U.S.A, the countries of Europe, Asia, Middle East,
 Africa etc., come to study here. The university has taken a leadership role in promoting new ideas, the spirit of integration of the world, and cultivation of intellect and cultur
e. Banaras Hindu University is small virtually a universe in microcosm.
